value.message: No underwater basket weaving turned up, but Acton Lion's Indoor Pool runs Parent & Tot swim (4 months-3 yrs), Oct 3 to Dec 3, $86.22 for 9 lessons - the Town of Halton Hills says; I couldn't pin down its day. Gellert has drop-in Parent & Tot 123, Tue/Thu from 10, per the Town; Halton Hills Gymnastics has Parent and Tot (18 mos-3.11), their site says.
